source_en: ID and form, filled in the bread line. Noe Barbaqadze, corner grocery.
I open the shop each morning, look at the empty shelves, and close.
Habit. Routine feels more normal than the alternative.
Last truck came before the blast. I'm still selling its matches.
My neighbor [[whisper:stopped answering his door]]. I saw him in the bread line yesterday.
He looked at me like we'd never met. Six years on the same landing.
Report what? A man who doesn't answer? Half the block doesn't.
I thought about leaving once. The exit line was too long.
